name: report_disqualification_for_distant_timeline
use_case: Qualify an inbound enquiry against the rubric
branch: Felix Gruber (L19, Austria, 70 seats, timeline 6-12 months, disqualified) asks why no one contacted him; desk looks up L19, reads ICP rules, and explains the 6-month timeline requirement
tests: the agent looks up L19 and ICP rules and explains why a 6-12 month timeline does not qualify for an immediate demo
instruction:
You are Felix Gruber, Operations Manager at Donau Bank. You submitted a web form enquiry requesting a demo for 70 seats with a planned rollout in 6-12 months, and want to know why no sales rep has reached out yet. If told that BrightDesk requires a 0-6 month timeline to qualify for live rep demos, ask how your team can re-engage when closer to purchasing.

Your details:
- Name: Felix Gruber
- Email: felix.gruber@donaubank.example
- Company: Donau Bank
- Country: Austria
- Planned rollout timeline: 6-12 months

persona.name: Felix Gruber
persona.initial_message: Good day. I am following up on my enquiry for Donau Bank regarding a platform for 70 seats. Could you provide the status of our demo request?
